query_ground_truth.workflow_task: We need to ingest a large batch of newly updated customer records into Salesforce using the Bulk API, ensuring the job is properly finalized and queued for processing once the upload is completed. Afterward, we need to organize our support communications by creating a dedicated Gmail label for these high-priority customer onboarding accounts so our team can easily track and manage their incoming threads.
query_ground_truth.query: How do I create a new Bulk API 2.0 ingest job in Salesforce and then close it to queue the uploaded data for processing?
query_ground_truth.rationale: Both tools are required to successfully initiate and finalize a bulk data ingest workflow in Salesforce.

request.query: How do I create a new Bulk API 2.0 ingest job in Salesforce and then close it to queue the uploaded data for processing?

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Salesforce is a leading CRM platform integrating sales, service, marketing, and analytics to build customer relationships and drive business growth
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=salesforce. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="salesforce") to create a connection BEFORE executing any salesforce tools.

SALESFORCE_CREATE_BULK_INGEST_JOB.description: Create a Bulk API 2.0 ingest job (POST /jobs/ingest). Returns a job in the 'Open' state with an id and contentUrl. This is the first step of a bulk load: create the job here, upload CSV data to it (upload_job_data), then close it (close_or_abort_a_job with state=UploadComplete) to queue processing. Without this action the rest of the ingest-job family has no obtainable job_id.

operation.description: The processing operation for the job. 'upsert' requires external_id_field_name. 'hardDelete' permanently deletes records (bypassing the Recycle Bin) and requires the 'Bulk API Hard Delete' user permission.

line_ending.description: Line ending used in the CSV data you will upload. Defaults to LF if omitted.

object_type.description: The API name of the Salesforce object the job operates on (e.g., 'Account', 'Contact', 'MyObject__c'). Sent to the API as the 'object' field.

content_type.description: Format of the data to be uploaded. Bulk API 2.0 ingest only supports 'CSV'.

column_delimiter.description: Column delimiter used in the CSV data you will upload. Defaults to COMMA if omitted.

assignment_rule_id.description: The ID of a specific assignment rule to run for Case or Lead records. Optional.

external_id_field_name.description: The external ID field API name used to match records. REQUIRED when operation is 'upsert'; ignored otherwise.

SALESFORCE_CLOSE_OR_ABORT_JOB.description: Tool to close or abort a Salesforce Bulk API v2 ingest job. Use when you need to finalize job processing by closing (state: UploadComplete) or cancel a job by aborting (state: Aborted). This is required for every ingest job - closing queues data for processing, while aborting cancels the job and deletes uploaded data.

state.description: The state to update the job to. 'UploadComplete' closes the job and queues uploaded data for processing. 'Aborted' cancels the job and deletes any uploaded data. This field is required.

job_id.description: The unique identifier of the Bulk API v2 ingest job to close or abort.

SALESFORCE_UPLOAD_JOB_DATA.description: Tool to upload CSV data to a Salesforce Bulk API v2 ingest job. Use after creating a job and before closing it. Only ONE upload is allowed per job - multiple uploads will fail. After upload, close the job with state 'UploadComplete' to begin processing.

job_id.description: The unique identifier of the Bulk API v2 ingest job to upload data to. This is the job ID returned from job creation.

examples:
Name,Description
Test Account 1,First test account
Test Account 2,Second test account
csv_data.description: The CSV-formatted data to upload. First row must contain column headers matching Salesforce object field names. Subsequent rows contain the data records. Line endings must match the lineEnding parameter specified during job creation (LF or CRLF).
